metas.name: 2026 · I Play Rocky
metas.description: A failing actor writes the ultimate underdog story and must fight for his chance to play the role of a lifetime - Rocky Balboa.

metas.name: 2026 · A Dog's Perfect Christmas
metas.description: A sage basset hound narrates how his family faces turmoil when Mrs. Goss falls into an induced coma, and a new Corgi pup helps unite the scattered household during their mother's absence.

metas.name: 2026 · A Story of Derry
metas.description: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Minotaur
metas.description: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · De Gaulle: Résistance
metas.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

metas.name: ★ 9.7 · 2026 · Summer Holidays
metas.description: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Mookuthi Amman 2
metas.description: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2026 · Yen Ennai Edho Seidhai
metas.description: Broken young man trapped in emotional darkness finds unexpected healing when Madhu's love guides him from self destruction toward hope, purpose, and light.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1991 · Europa
metas.description: Just after World War II, an American takes a railway job in Germany, but finds his position politically sensitive with various people trying to use him.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2023 · Paachuvum Albhuthavilakkum
metas.description: A middle-class Malayali youth who is settled in Mumbai and revolves around incidents that take place on a journey to Kerala.

metas.name: 2026 · Cupertino
metas.description: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

metas.name: 2026 · American Hostage
metas.description: Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter, is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker, Tony Kiritsis, demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2019 · First Cow
metas.description: In 1820, a cook travels to Oregon, where he meets a Chinese immigrant who is also looking to make his fortune. Soon, they team up in a dangerous scheme to steal milk from a prized local cow, the first and only in the territory.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · The Woman in the Line
metas.description: Andrea visits her incarcerated son for the first time. Initially eyed with suspicion by other women in line, she gradually gains their trust — and emerges as a powerful advocate for justice reform.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · A Love Other Than Yours
metas.description: A realistic, relatable melodrama in which a familiar lover faces unfamiliar emotions after 10 years of dating.

metas.name: 2026 · Drive - The Pretenders
metas.description: A young race car mechanic pretends to be engaged to the most scandalous racing star in the scene - officially for his reputation, but secretly for her own chance behind the wheel. Soon the lie threatens to destroy everything.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · The Dark
metas.description: A detective investigates a mysterious death in the Scottish countryside, suspecting it's the start of a deadly pattern threatening the peaceful rural community.

metas.name: ★ 9.7 · 2026 · Magazine
metas.description: Bored, privileged, and convinced his life has zero plot, a drama-hungry Gen Z cinephile leaves the city for his ancestral village in search of some main-character energy, hoping life will finally give him something worth talking about, but an unlikely friendship, a new world, and one unexpected twist soon turn his own life into the story he's been waiting for.
